setup.title: Set Up Your Company Profile
setup.body: Create your company profile to start matching with government tenders.

profileView.noMatchYet: <1>No match has run yet.</1> Keywords will be extracted from your description when you run your first match. The more specific it is, the better your results.
profileView.weakKeywords_one: <1>Weak keyword extraction:</1> only {{count}} domain-specific term was found in your description. Enrich it with specific technologies, platforms, certifications, and sectors to improve match quality before running a match.
profileView.weakKeywords_other: <1>Weak keyword extraction:</1> only {{count}} domain-specific terms were found in your description. Enrich it with specific technologies, platforms, certifications, and sectors to improve match quality before running a match.

placeholders.servicesDescription: e.g. We implement and support SAP and Oracle ERP systems for mid-size manufacturers, including S/4HANA migrations, system integrations, and managed cloud hosting. Our team holds SAP Activate certification and has delivered 30+ projects across automotive and industrial sectors.

tooltips.companyName: Your legal or trading name. Used for internal reference only.
tooltips.companySize: Your headcount range. Informational context for the AI scorer.
tooltips.industries: NAICS classifications for your business. The AI uses these to assess whether a tender is in your domain.
tooltips.servicesDescription: Describe what your company does in specific terms. Domain keywords are extracted from this text. The more precise, the better your matches.
tooltips.keywords: Specific technologies, products, or platforms your company works with. Each keyword is matched word-for-word against every tender before AI scoring. Strong signal for relevance.
tooltips.certifications: Professional or trade certifications your company holds. The AI references these when assessing whether a tender requires credentials you have.
tooltips.commodityTypes: Whether your company sells goods, services, or both. Tenders whose category clearly conflicts with your selection are rejected before AI scoring.
tooltips.preferredOrgs: Hard filter. Only tenders issued by these buying organizations will be scored. Leave empty to receive tenders from all organizations.
tooltips.preferredNtTypes: Hard filter. Only tenders of these types will be scored. Leave empty to receive all notice types.
tooltips.preferredProvinces: Hard filter on delivery region. Only applies when a tender specifies where work must be delivered. Tenders with no delivery region are always included.
tooltips.excludeKeywords: Hard filter. Any tender containing these words anywhere in its title or description is rejected before scoring.

validation.industries: Please select at least one industry.
validation.commodityTypes: Please select at least one commodity type.
validation.descriptionMin: At least 150 characters required. Be specific about technologies, platforms, and sectors you serve.

form.descriptionHelp: Be specific: name technologies, platforms, certifications, and sectors. Vague descriptions produce fewer keyword matches.
form.prefsWarning: ⚠ <1>These are hard filters.</1> Tenders that don't match every active filter are rejected before the AI ever sees them. They will never appear in your results. Leave a filter empty to place no restriction on that field.
form.preferredProvincesNote: Tenders with no specified delivery region are never filtered out by this setting.

confirmModal.createBody: Create your company profile? You can edit it at any time after creation.
confirmModal.saveBody: Save changes to your profile? If your description changed, keywords will be re-extracted on your next match run.

trigger.inProgress: Matching is already in progress or pending.

matches.empty: No matches found. Try running matching first.
